title.narrative: Building Community Resilience to Recurrent Droughts in Marsabit

description.narrative:
The Diocese of Marsabit Project on Building Community Resilience to Recurrent Droughts will be implemented in the districts of Marsabit, Chalbi, Laisamis and Moyale in Northern Kenya. This is a two year project targeting Kargi, Sololo (Walda), Hurri Hills and Dirib Gombo locations that are adversely affected by the impacts of recurrent and prolonged droughts. The project is targeting 5,300 drought-prone men and women living in the target locations.
The Overall goal of the project is to build safer, resilient and sustainable communities in Kargi, Huri Hills, Sololo and Dirib Gombo in Marsabi tin the light of recurrent droughts. The project has three closely interrelated outcomes that include; improved community and partner capacity to effectively engage in drought preparedness and mitigation reduced crop losses due to drought and improved environmental conservation and sustainable management of natural resources.
The Project will endeavour to promote community participation through establishing a complaints handling mechanism to enable target communities provide feedback on the progress of the proposed project and have project staff responding to their feedback in a constructive manner. The project will also mainstream HIV and AIDS and Gender through having gender considerations factored in during the beneficiary's selection processes and through awareness creation. The development of this project has been closely informed by a two year DRR pilot project that was implemented in the Diocese of Marsabit in 2009 to 2011. During the implementation of the pilot project, the Diocese of Marsabit realised the benefit of investing in DRR activities rather than focusing purely on emergency intervention programmes as far as reducing disaster losses and safeguarding the development gains realised through development programming.
